A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''captain''' in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] was disgraced and assigned to a [[Gage-class transport|''Gage''-class transport]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. As a last act of redemption, the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] ordered his [[Unidentified Gage-class transport|vessel]] to ram into a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] battle station.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
